record.title: Customs Tariff Commission Announcement No. 6 (2026) on adjusting additional tariff measures on imported goods originating in the United States
record.issuer: Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council (CTC)
record.relation_note: Continues No. 10's one-year suspension: from 13:01 on 10 Nov 2026, for two months, the 24 percentage points remain suspended and 10% is retained
record.note: The MOF original-text URL was located via a Tsinghua CIFER citation, and official-media republications (Xinhua and others) agree; the MOF original was not opened directly this round, hence grade B; the 'two months' expiry is registered as 10 Jan 2027, with the exact wording to be verified against the original text (intake open item S-03).
